question: The Sixteenth Finance Commission (FC-16) recommended the review and closure of how many inactive State Public Sector Enterprises (SPSEs)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**308.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 16th Finance Commission (FC-16) report, tabled on February 1, 2026, proposed major reforms for State Public Sector Enterprises (SPSEs).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Commission recommended a review and closure of 308 inactive State Public Sector Enterprises (SPSEs) to improve fiscal discipline.**
 
• It advised states to formulate a state-level disinvestment policy specifically targeting inactive and underperforming enterprises.
 
• A key threshold was suggested: State or Union PSEs incurring losses for three out of four consecutive years should be placed before the respective Cabinet for a decision.
 
• The Cabinet's decision on such loss-making units could involve closure, privatisation, or continuation based on strategic importance.
 
• SPSE Reform Highlights:__
 __
 
• Target for closure - 308 inactive units
 
• Loss threshold - 3 out of 4 consecutive years
 
• Policy requirement - State-level disinvestment policy
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• SPSEs (State Public Sector Enterprises)__

 __
 
• Companies in which the State Government has a majority shareholding (51% or more).
 
 
 
• Disinvestment__
 __
 
• The process of a government selling or liquidating its assets or stakes in public sector enterprises to reduce fiscal burden or raise funds.
 
 
 
• Fiscal Deficit Link__
 __
 
• Closing inactive SPSEs helps reduce the hidden fiscal burden on state budgets, as these units often require government support despite being unproductive.
 
 
 
• Privatisation__
 
 
• The transfer of ownership, property, or business from the government to the private sector.
